episodes.title: Volver del infierno
episodes.summary: Amid global turmoil, just-out-of-prison Max joins his parents in a luxury bunker. There, an unexpected encounter confronts him with his darkest past.

episodes.title: La gran estafa de la humanidad
episodes.summary: As the team celebrates their success, not everyone feels comfortable with how the events unfolded. Rafa reels from Frida's revelations.

episodes.title: Odio a los ricos
episodes.summary: A shocked Minerva faces a skeptical team in need of answers. Conflicted by the videos of Max, Asia makes a rash decision but later regrets it.

episodes.title: La paradoja del millonario
episodes.summary: In a medical crisis, Asia is the only one who can help. Victoria welcomes a distraction as she sends out mayday signals. A call grows in urgency.

episodes.title: La verdad está sobrevalorada
episodes.summary: With pressure mounting, Minerva takes a major gamble before assigning a high-stakes mission. Unable to find Guillermo, Mimi turns to Frida and Victoria.

episodes.title: La mujer de los días contados
episodes.summary: Asia comes to grips with her true feelings. Max confronts Minerva as she prepares to implement phase three in the bunker. Mimi shows troubling symptoms.

episodes.title: Aprende a vivir sin mí
episodes.summary: Under false pretenses, Max unveils his plan. Rafa reveals the real reason behind his past actions while Guillermo prioritizes family and friendship.

episodes.title: Dos minutos sin Roxán
episodes.summary: Frida doesn't hold back as she delivers some painful truths. As a perfectly curated night unfolds, Max and Asia kick into action.
